trailhead.label: The car park on Via Papa Giovanni XXIII by the lake in Riva di Solto, the published start

cautions: About 0.5 km of mountain path (T2) on the stepped path down beside the Bogn gorge: rocky steps, steep in places and slippery when wet; sure footing needed.
You cross the lakeside main road by the Riva di Solto tunnel, where the board asks for particular care, and the SP 77 at a pedestrian crossing in Solto Collina: keep your dog on a short lead.

Almost half the walk is on asphalt lanes and village streets, with about 150 m along Via Papa Giovanni XXIII (the SP 77) at the start and the lakeside promenade beside the SS469 at the end: keep your dog close there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About 0.5 km of mountain path (T2) on th: Circa 0,5 km di sentiero di montagna (T2) sul sentiero a gradoni accanto all’orrido del Bogn: gradini di roccia, a tratti ripidi e scivolosi col bagnato; serve passo sicuro.
textIt.You cross the lakeside main road by the: Si attraversa la strada costiera vicino alla galleria di Riva di Solto, dove l’ente chiede particolare attenzione, e la SP 77 sulle strisce pedonali a Solto Collina: tenete il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Almost half the walk is on asphalt lanes: Quasi metà del percorso è su stradine asfaltate e vie di paese, con circa 150 m lungo via Papa Giovanni XXIII (la SP 77) alla partenza e il lungolago accanto alla SS469 alla fine: lì tenete il cane vicino.
